name: Elephant Walk
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart and fold forward at the hips. Put your hands on the floor, or on blocks if you cannot reach it.
Bend one knee and keep the other leg straight, so you feel a stretch in the hamstring of the straight leg.
Straighten the bent knee as you bend the other one, like a slow walk on the spot.
Keep your hands down and your head relaxed. Count each knee change as one repetition.
